encoding.frame_policy: caption overlay only; no interpolation, frame insertion, slow motion, or temporal retiming

visual_review.overview: caption stays in the outer top margin and the 256-environment grid remains visible
visual_review.closeup: caption stays at the top edge and leaves the selected environment's gripper, plug, and adapter workspace visible

verification.caption_sample_visual_check: frames 0, 480, and 959 show 0.02 s / 0 updates, 8.02 s / 7 updates, and 16.00 s / 14 updates in both views

limitations: The overview and close-up are independent fresh runs with the same pinned configuration; they are not two synchronized cameras from one run.
The videos record real vectorized PPO learning rollouts, but they do not demonstrate a trained insertion-success policy.
The complete training call finished 20 PPO updates; the captured window spans active rollouts 0 through 14, with 14 updates complete before the final captured rollout.
The raw RSL-RL runner field ends at 13 because it is sampled before the current rollout update is committed; it must not be presented as the corrected completed-update count.
Captioning re-encodes the pixels with H.264; frame count, order, rate, duration, and timing are preserved, and all 960 decoded frames remain distinct in each result.
No claim is made about real-hardware transfer, camera sensor fusion, or insertion success from these media files alone.
